1. Publishing skips the PR's real state 📘 Rule violation
>
>Description >
> >
>publish() uses the saved s.posted count instead of checking the live PR body and owner's
>comments before deciding that all proofs are present. If a proof is removed from the description, a
>comment is deleted, or a comment fails to post while the count remains complete, later runner steps
>and /agent retries do not restore the missing proof.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[scripts/agent-watch.mjs[R284-285]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/65/files#diff-f7a957c7057d24a400ef5397057df1a0e02dfb0d178acf2e726ae0b02470a362R284-R285) > >```diff >+ const done = s.posted || 0; >+ if (done >= s.proofs.length) return; >``` >
>

2. Proofs marked posted before they land 📘 Rule violation
>
>Description >
> >
>publish() sets s.posted to the full proof count and saves it before patching the PR description
>or posting proof comments. If a gh call fails or the process stops between those operations,
>continueRun() sees the saved count and returns early, leaving the missing description or comments
>unpublished.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[scripts/agent-watch.mjs[R287-290]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/65/files#diff-f7a957c7057d24a400ef5397057df1a0e02dfb0d178acf2e726ae0b02470a362R287-R290) > >```diff >+ s.posted = s.proofs.length; save(n, s); >+ writeFileSync(join(HOME, `${n}-pr-body.md`), prBody(n, s)); >+ write(`update PR #${s.pr}'s description`, () => gh('api', '-X', 'PATCH', `repos/${REPO}/pulls/${s.pr}`, '-F', `body=@${join(HOME, `${n}-pr-body.md`)}`, '--jq', '.number')); >+ for (const p of fresh) comment(s.pr, p); // a PR is an issue, so this is the same call as ticket comments >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >`publish()` saves the full proof count before the PR description PATCH and proof comments complete. A failed `gh` call or interruption can therefore leave the saved count claiming publication is complete, causing recovery to skip missing writes. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- scripts/agent-watch.mjs[282-291] >- scripts/runner-lib.mjs[102-110] > >## Recommended Fix >Use `publishPlan` to determine outstanding body and comment writes from GitHub during recovery. Move the `s.posted` update and save until after the required PATCH and comment calls succeed, then re-check the PR body and owner's comments before persisting the marker. Ensure recovery still handles a successful PATCH followed by only some successful comments. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

3. Existing pull requests get duplicate proofs 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>publish() treats an absent s.posted as zero and posts every proof after the first without
>checking existing comments. State files saved by the previous runner have no such field, so the next
>tick on an existing multi-proof PR repeats comments that were already published.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[scripts/agent-watch.mjs[R284-286]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/65/files#diff-f7a957c7057d24a400ef5397057df1a0e02dfb0d178acf2e726ae0b02470a362R284-R286) > >```diff >+ const done = s.posted || 0; >+ if (done >= s.proofs.length) return; >+ const fresh = s.proofs.slice(Math.max(done, 1)); >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Existing state files have no `posted` count, and treating them as zero reposts already-published proof comments. >## Fix Focus Areas >- scripts/agent-watch.mjs[282-290] >- scripts/runner-lib.mjs[102-110] >## Recommended Fix >For state without `posted`, inspect the PR body and owner comments before selecting work. Use the remote comparison to post only missing proofs and initialize any retained count only after reconciliation. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
